about: The custom hero's options (docs/art/creator.md). The game (world/look/hero_look.gd) and the art tools (tools/art/creator_art.py, blender/creator_pieces.py) both read this file. Prompts describe what Gemini draws on the keyed base figures; labels and summaries are what the player reads.

builds.label: Slender
builds.prompt: a slender, lightly built {person} of average height, with narrow shoulders, thin arms and a slim waist

builds.label: Average
builds.prompt: a {person} of average height and average build

builds.label: Broad
builds.prompt: a broad, heavyset {person} of average height, with very wide shoulders, thick muscular arms, a barrel chest and a heavy waist

heads.label: Sharp
heads.prompt: a sharp, angular face with high cheekbones, a long straight nose and a narrow pointed chin

heads.label: Round
heads.prompt: a soft, round face with full cheeks, a small upturned nose and a dimpled chin

heads.label: Weathered
heads.prompt: an older, weathered face with deep lines, a heavy brow, sunken cheeks and a pale scar across one cheek

heads.label: Elfin
heads.prompt: fine, delicate features with large almond eyes, high cheekbones and long pointed elven ears

heads.label: Horned
heads.prompt: a pair of short ridged horns curving back from the temples, painted dark bone grey (not green and not magenta), and a fierce brow

heads.label: Tusked
heads.prompt: a heavy square jaw with two short tusks jutting up from the lower lip, a broad flat nose and small pointed ears

hair.label: Cropped
hair.prompt: very short cropped hair close to the scalp

hair.label: Long
hair.prompt: long straight hair falling past the shoulders to the middle of the back

hair.label: Braid
hair.prompt: hair pulled back tight into one thick braid hanging down the back to the shoulder blades

hair.label: Topknot
hair.prompt: hair pulled up tight into a round knot on the crown of the head

hair.label: Curls
hair.prompt: a full, rounded head of tight curls

hair.label: Crest
hair.prompt: the sides of the head shaved bare, with a short crest of hair running along the top from brow to nape

beards.label: Stubble
beards.prompt: a short, rough stubble shadow over the jaw, chin and upper lip

beards.label: Moustache
beards.prompt: a thick, drooping moustache and no beard

beards.label: Goatee
beards.prompt: a pointed goatee on the chin joined to a thin moustache

beards.label: Full beard
beards.prompt: a full, short-trimmed beard joined to a moustache

beards.label: Long beard
beards.prompt: a long, full beard reaching down to the chest, with a moustache

beards.label: Braided
beards.prompt: a long beard worked into two thick braids hanging to the chest, with a moustache

outfits.label: Sellsword's mail
outfits.summary: Chain mail under a faded red tabard, and a longsword at the hip.
outfits.prompt: a mercenary's kit: a short-sleeved chain mail shirt over a padded gambeson, a faded blood-red tabard belted with brown leather, leather bracers, dark grey trousers and tall brown boots, with a longsword in a scabbard at the left hip

attack.windup: {they} draws the longsword from the hip and raises it high over the right shoulder in both hands, body coiled back
attack.strike: {they} slashes the longsword down and across in front, lunging forward on the front foot, arms extended

outfits.label: Shadow's leathers
outfits.summary: Close-fitting dark leathers, a half-cape and a pair of long daggers.
outfits.prompt: a thief's kit: a fitted dark brown leather jerkin with buckled straps over a charcoal shirt, a short charcoal half-cape over one shoulder, dark trousers, soft knee-high boots, a belt of small pouches and a long dagger sheathed on each hip

attack.windup: {they} draws a long dagger and crouches low, the dagger hand pulled back by the hip, the other hand forward
attack.strike: {they} lunges forward and stabs the dagger straight out at chest height, the other arm swept back for balance

outfits.label: Scholar's robes
outfits.summary: Long blue-violet robes, a satchel of scrolls and a crystal-tipped staff.
outfits.prompt: a scholar-mage's robes: a long deep blue-violet robe with wide sleeves and a dark red sash, a leather satchel of scrolls on a strap across the chest, soft dark boots, and a tall wooden staff topped with a small pale crystal held upright in the right hand

attack.windup: {they} plants the feet and draws the staff back over the shoulder, the free hand raised beside the head with the fingers spread
attack.strike: {they} thrusts the staff out toward the target at arm's length, the crystal tip pointed straight ahead, the free hand flung back

outfits.label: Pilgrim's vestments
outfits.summary: A bone-white surcoat with a stitched sun over mail, a mace and a holy symbol.
outfits.prompt: a travelling priest's vestments: a knee-length bone-white surcoat with a gold sunburst stitched on the chest over a chain mail shirt, a dark red stole, a brown leather belt, grey trousers and brown boots, with a flanged mace at the belt and a silver sun symbol on a chain round the neck

attack.windup: {they} raises the flanged mace high over the head in one hand, the other hand holding the silver sun symbol out in front
attack.strike: {they} brings the mace down in a heavy overhead blow in front, stepping forward, the symbol hand braced at the chest

outfits.label: Duelist's finery
outfits.summary: A slashed crimson doublet, a short black cape and a rapier.
outfits.prompt: a duelist's finery: a fitted dark crimson doublet with brass buttons and slashed sleeves, a short black cape over one shoulder, a white shirt collar, black breeches, tall black boots, leather gloves, and a rapier in a scabbard at the left hip

attack.windup: {they} draws the rapier and settles into a fencing stance, the sword arm drawn back with the point raised, the free hand up behind
attack.strike: {they} lunges deep forward, front knee bent and back leg straight, the rapier thrust straight out at full stretch

outfits.label: Wildling's furs
outfits.summary: Hide and a grey wolf-fur mantle, forearm wraps and a hand axe.
outfits.prompt: a wilderness wanderer's kit: a sleeveless hide jerkin, a heavy grey wolf-fur mantle over the shoulders, leather wraps on the forearms, rough brown trousers bound with cord at the shins, fur-trimmed boots, and a hand axe at the belt

attack.windup: {they} raises the hand axe high over the shoulder in one hand, body twisting back, the free arm out for balance
attack.strike: {they} chops the axe down and across in front with full force, stepping forward onto the front foot

portraits.prompt: a weathered human woman sellsword in her thirties with close-cropped dark hair, a pale scar through one eyebrow and steady grey eyes, wearing a dark travelling coat with a high collar over chain mail
a young human man in his twenties with tousled chestnut hair, stubble and a crooked grin, wearing a worn dark leather jerkin with a dagger hilt over his shoulder
a cool, poised elven woman with long silver-white hair, long pointed ears and violet eyes, wearing deep blue-violet scholar's robes with a pale crystal pendant
a broad dwarven man with a long red beard worked into two braids, a bald scalp with faded blue tattoos and a heavy grey wolf-fur mantle
a tiefling woman with dark ridged horns curving back from her temples, deep red skin, gold eyes and black hair in a high knot, wearing a dark crimson duelist's doublet
a human man in his fifties with grey hair, a lined, kind face and a short grey beard, a travelling priest in a bone-white surcoat with a silver sun symbol on a chain
a half-orc woman with grey-green skin, two short tusks, a crest of black hair along her shaved head and a grey wolf-fur mantle over her shoulders
a halfling woman with a mop of bright auburn curls, freckles and a gap-toothed smile, wearing a dark leather jerkin with a half-cape
a dark-skinned human man in his forties with close-cropped black hair and a neat black beard, a scholar-mage in deep blue-violet robes with a satchel strap across his chest
a pale young noblewoman with long black hair in a single braid over her shoulder, sharp features and dark eyes, wearing a black and crimson doublet with a rapier hilt rising behind her shoulder
